title: 湿乾両用の業務用掃除機
description: 建物や作業場の清掃シーン向けの湿乾両用集じん機。金属タンク、キャスター、蓋留め、上部モーター外装、蛇腹ホース、金属パイプ、床用ノズルと背面コードを造形。液体や粉じん、フィルター・電動機内部、吸引・通電・走行はなく、集じん性能や安全認証は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.672 × 0.797 × 0.892 m、24,956三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wet/dry vacuum prop for building and workshop cleaning scenes, with metal drum, casters, lid latches, motor-head exterior, corrugated hose, steel wand, floor nozzle and rear cable. Liquids, dust, filters and motor internals, suction, powered and rolling behavior are absent; collection performance and safety certification are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.672 × 0.797 × 0.892 m; 24,956 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
